title: ETH-refutation technique (openai/math 378) does not transfer to ECDLP
question: ETH-technique transfer (ECDLP-46; source openai/math family 378, external, not peer reviewed): negative on every route, no prototype (decision gate not met). Direct CNF route: affine encoding ~48 ell^2.83 variables, ladder ~503 ell^2.41; with time 2^{C n/sqrt(ln n)} beating rho requires n/ell < sqrt(ln n)/(2C), impossible for n = c ell^a, a>1. Paper parameters (Lemma 4.8, beta=1) only become non-vacuous at log2 n ~ 1e10. Technique route: (a) summation-polynomial decomposition even with free oracle costs p^{2/(m+1)} total; S_3 test encoding ~45.5 (log2 p)^2 variables; (b) predicates on x alone are Q-independent; (c) output bits of x(kP) have ANF density ~0.5 up to degree ell (no sparse form).
